Zombie Survival Garry's Mod is a game where a group of Survivors are present in an apocalyptic world with a threat of an incoming zombie horde hungry for their brains. Humans must prepare and work together and fight-off the zombies in order to prevail.

games.name: Randomly Generated Droids
games.desc:
The Halloween Event is back with six exclusive classes to obtain and a new soundtrack!

Randomly Generated Droids is a procedurally-generated roguelike focused heavily on sword-fighting mechanics. Every run is different from the last: face several different Droids as you continually get stronger.

🤖 Battle over fifty enemy varieties as you travel through a series of fleshed-out worlds! 
🎓 Various classes to unlock and purchase, with each directly influencing how you play the game!
⚔️ Over fifty weapons and a hundred items to experiment with as you fight your way to the end!
👥 You can play this game solo, or you can play with a party of up to four people!
📈 Is the game somehow too easy for you? Stack up ascension levels for a challenge!

Join the RGD Fans! group here: https://www.roblox.com/groups/5398551

Welcome to Princess Tycoon 😄, choose your favorite princess 👸 and build 🧱 your tycoon!

games.name: Tower FL
games.desc:
Tower FL is a tower obby with randomly generated stages. There are no checkpoints! Can you race other players to the top?

Win coins for every stage you finish. Use your coins to open boxes in the shop and see how many cool cosmetics you can get, Can you collect them all?

VIP server owners can use the settings menu to skip rounds, change the tower size, and lock the shop and commands in chat here:
/skip to skip tower
/setlength (number of stages 4-200) to set how many stages you want
/lock or /unlock to lock the shop

games.name: TIMELESS
games.desc:
During a violent outbreak in Robloxia, an Agency has been created to keep the remaining survivors safe. Your mission is to team up with your fellow emissaries to investigate dangerous areas. But be careful, and use your skills to your advantage.

TIMELESS is a 1v8 asymmetrical horror game that revolves around general Roblox media. The game takes big inspiration from The Disaster by OutLaikRBLX, and Left 4 Dead.
WARNING: This game contains flashing/bright lights

[KEYBINDS]:

[PC]
-Q, F, R, T : Using Abilities
-Left Control : Toggle ShiftLock
-V : Toggle POV
-R : Revive
-C : Carry
-G : Emote
-X : Open/Close chat wheel

[CONTROLLER]
-Y, L1, R1, L3 : Using Abilities
-L2 : Sprinting
-DPadUp : Toggle ShiftLock
-B : Revive
-DPadRight : Carry
-DPadDown : Emote
-X : Open/Close chat wheel

(Keybinds can be edited in settings)

(⚠️DISCLAIMER⚠️) This is a recreation of Landfall/Landfall West's "Stick Fight: The Game" which is available on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch. In-game music was created by Karl Flodin for the original Stick Fight: The Game. If you want an experience that's made by actual good developers, the original Stick Fight: The Game is only $4.99.

This game makes Roblox into a 2D game, so expect bugs and issues. Certain aspects like server performance and mobile support are not the best, so it's highly recommended to play in a Private Server if you can.

Right Click & F / L2 = Block
F / Y Button = Throw Weapon
A & D / Left Joystick = Movement
